title: audit-recurrent-kv-finalization
summary: Audit vLLM-RLT synchronous early-exit KV propagation, later depth-specific attention reads, and request storage retirement. Use when shallow token exits leave deeper history or release order in question.

skill_metadata.name: audit-recurrent-kv-finalization
skill_metadata.description: Audit vLLM-RLT synchronous early-exit KV propagation, later depth-specific attention reads, and request storage retirement. Use when shallow token exits leave deeper history or release order in question.

applicability.scope: Pinned vLLM-RLT native Ouro synchronous scheduling with host KVMetadata: LAST_EXITED propagation versus SHARED, later depth-specific Torch-reference attention and normal release/wait/free order. No speculation, connector, preemption, prefix sharing, split/packed prefill or graph/static-buffer path qualification.
applicability.prerequisites: The selected native Ouro synchronous path uses host KVMetadata, no speculation/connector/preemption, atomic prefill and disabled graph/static-buffer/packed-prefill paths; changed execution conditions need a new bounded check.
applicability.input_contract: Repository revision, model/configuration, recurrent-layer set, loop count, cache layout and block size, dtype/device, attention backend and effective flags, plus the traced token/depth/layer and its next consumer.
applicability.produced_artifact: A bounded token/finalization/consumer/retirement trace separating source call order, observed data and written validity, completion evidence and remaining native model/backend/performance gaps.
applicability.failure_modes: Substituting mark_finalized for K/V propagation, accepting allocated pages as a complete written prefix, applying LAST_EXITED copy expectations to SHARED, or treating event recording as completion can invalidate the ownership diagnosis.
applicability.refusal_point: On a failed prerequisite or complete-prefix check, retain the first failing token/depth/layer and trace the missing operation. Stop the conclusion when flags or metadata ownership leave the selected path.

limitations: Source-derived candidate; native CPU/CUDA, model correctness/quality, performance and agent efficacy are not validated.
Allocated capacity, host written-position validity, copied K/V bytes, event recording and completed device work are distinct; host-row checks do not qualify DeviceKVMetadata.
Repository Apache-2.0 and retained model/configuration NOTICE attribution do not constitute a whole-tree or model-weight license audit.
recommendations: Distinguish copied K/V values, logical written positions and allocated capacity; follow the later depth-specific attention consumer.
Preserve executed shallower values during LAST_EXITED propagation and use SHARED as a separate one-plane control.
Follow the latest request event through runner release before scheduler cache release; page reuse is not evidence of erased old bytes.
